activity_statements.statement: produces and delivers essential industrial gases including hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen, argon and helium to 30+ industries across 50 countries via 750+ production facilities and 1,800 miles of pipeline
develops, engineers, builds, owns and operates large-scale hydrogen projects as the leading global hydrogen supplier
sells industrial gas equipment including turbomachinery, membrane systems and cryogenic containers to customers globally through equipment businesses
provides applications expertise and on-site gas production to refining, chemicals, metals, electronics, manufacturing, medical and food industries
operates large-scale facilities under long-term customer contracts enabling gases used in semiconductor fabrication, food freezing, MRI imaging and aerospace applications

name_reality_gap: Labeled Chemical Manufacturing; Air Products is primarily an industrial gases and energy infrastructure company — it does not make chemicals for sale but rather supplies the gases that enable chemical manufacturing, electronics, medical imaging, and is now a major clean-hydrogen infrastructure developer.
extraction_notes: Single strong source. FY25 revenue $12B confirmed. Hydrogen strategy and energy transition positioning well-documented. Equipment businesses clearly described as separate revenue line.
